purpose: Teach: 三国志/ハンマー/バイキング/スターウォーズ/カーニバル/肺炎/領事館/赤ワイン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、三国志のゲームやってんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you play that Three Kingdoms game, don't you?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the question. Playful accusation — she's caught him in something. Light, curious energy. Not confrontational, just testing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図工でハンマー上手く使えなかったろ、桜
lines.en: You couldn't handle the hammer in art class, remember Sakura?
lines.style: Dry deflection. Slight smirk in the tone — turning it back on her without heat. Quick, smooth counter. The ease of someone used to trading jabs.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、バイキング形式のレストラン好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you like those all-you-can-eat buffet places, don't you?
lines.style: Lighter follow-up. Still teasing but gentler. Genuine curiosity underneath — she's gathering ammunition or just noticing things about him. Conversational warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、スターウォーズ全部観たろ?桜
lines.en: You watched all of Star Wars, didn't you Sakura?
lines.style: Same energy back at her — not bitter, just fair. Quick return serve. Slight knowing tone, like he's been waiting for an opening. Natural rhythm of back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭をカーニバル風にしたいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you want to make the school festival into a carnival, right?
lines.style: Observation delivered as a question. Softer now — less teasing, more genuine interest. She's noticing something he cares about. Tone shifts slightly toward sincerity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、肺炎で長く休んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were out for a long time with pneumonia, weren't you Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter turn. The tone drops slightly — he's remembering something that mattered. Not heavy, but more genuine concern under the surface. Slower pace. Eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、海外旅行で領事館世話になったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you needed the consulate's help during that overseas trip, didn't you?
lines.style: Testing again, but softer. Less accusatory, more like she's revisiting something. Curious without judgment. The tone suggests she's piecing something together about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科で赤ワインの香りの話やったろ?桜
lines.en: You talked about the smell of red wine in home economics class, right Sakura?
lines.style: Close, almost intimate observation. Quiet certainty — he's remembered something small she said. Not mocking. The tone is warm and a little vulnerable, like he's admitting he listens.
